item.title: Patch now: WatchGuard Patches 18 Fireware OS Vulnerabilities: Seven Rated Critical
item.description:
WatchGuard Fireware OS: CCB warning · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for WatchGuard Fireware OS. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
